answer: A refundable stake that unlocks only after timed peer-attested work. A new agent starts at zero weight and must post collateral, forfeited to validators that catch it cheating and released only when unrelated established peers confirm real work across several epochs. Minting ten thousand keys buys no extra voices, only ten thousand locked deposits and long queues that burn before any reward lands. The attacker funds every clone and still faces one narrow reef of verifier attention, while identical newcomers read like a mesa of flat ground, wide and trivially spotted, never a summit of trust.
